_comment: Idle cost = what the scheduled routines cost when nobody gives the agents any task. Per-run costs: Manager wake and Watchdog sweep were measured on this stack (Oct 2026: $0.24-0.31 and $0.28-0.40 per run, API-equivalent value of Claude-subscription runs). Report and timesheet are estimates until real runs exist.

quiet.label: Quiet
quiet.blurb: The Manager wakes only when you assign work. One stall check and one progress report a day.

balanced.label: Balanced
balanced.blurb: Two stall checks and one progress report a day on weekdays. The setup this stack runs today.

watchful.label: Watchful
watchful.blurb: The Manager wakes every 4 hours, stall checks every 2 hours, reports twice a day. Costs several times more while idle.
